---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement or new capability for DëvSec
title: "[feature] "
labels: [enhancement]
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that DëvSec doesn't currently support? Describe the user-visible gap, not the implementation.

## Proposed approach

A short sketch of how you'd like this to work. Mention which surface it affects (CLI flag, scanner, dashboard view, Honey Keys, IOC pack, etc.).

## Fit with the local-first stance

DëvSec is local-first by design: no telemetry, no cloud LLM, no SaaS uploads. Briefly note how your proposal fits within that boundary, or which trade-offs it would require. See PROVOCATION.md and the trust boundary diagram if you need a refresher.

## Alternatives considered

Other ways to solve the same problem, and why this one is preferred.

## Additional context

Links to related cases, scanners, ADRs, or upstream issues that motivated the request.
